lines.quote: Design and implement phased-array beamforming algorithms for Meridian’s ground-based electronic warfare receiver product line, including MVDR spatial filtering and adaptive sidelobe cancellation for broadband targets

implemented real-time beamforming and channelisation kernels in C targeting TI TMS320C6678 multicore DSP processors for Meridian’s fielded receiver systems; wrote the interrupt service routines, DMA configuration, and memory management layer

built and maintain the automated regression test suite (~3,200 test cases) for Meridian’s digital receiver signal processing chain; includes waveform generation, expected-output computation, and pass/fail reporting via Jenkins CI

requirements.name: RF measurement experience
